feature_blocks.title: Prepare each listing with a clearer base before publishing
feature_blocks.text: Upload product photos and add the essential details such as brand, size, measurements or price. Vinbot helps turn that information into a cleaner draft so you can review it before the first listing goes live.
points: Start from the real details you add for each item.
Generate a title and description proposal.
Review and adjust the content before publishing.
feature_blocks.closing: AI helps you move faster; the final decision is still yours.

feature_blocks.title: Keep your items active without relying on daily memory
feature_blocks.text: When you manage many listings, renewing items manually ends up taking a huge share of the day. Vinbot lets you define a renewal routine so this repetitive task stays organised.
points: Choose which items should be included in the renewal routine.
Set how you want the routine to work.
Keep a clear view of which items remain active.
feature_blocks.closing: You define the strategy; Vinbot reduces the repetitive work.

feature_blocks.title: Use the interest without writing the same message over and over
feature_blocks.text: When someone shows interest in one of your articles, answering quickly can be useful, but repeating the same process dozens of times consumes time. Vinbot lets you configure responses to likes and keep this part of the workflow more organised.
points: Configure the message you want to use.
Centralise actions related to people who are interested.
Review activity and pending replies from your dashboard.
feature_blocks.closing: The goal is not to sound automated: it is to avoid repeating tasks you have already defined.

feature_blocks.title: Negotiate by your rules, not by random discounts
feature_blocks.text: Each item has a margin and every seller has a different way of negotiating. Vinbot helps apply a coherent logic to offers and conversations, based on the limits you have defined.
points: Set the minimum price or the margin you want to protect.
Decide what kind of discount you are willing to consider.
Maintain consistent responses when several negotiations are open.
feature_blocks.closing: Before automating a negotiation, you define the conditions.

feature_blocks.title: Decide how you want to negotiate before the conversation begins
feature_blocks.text: Automation only makes sense when it reflects how you sell. This section lets you define a negotiation strategy before activating it: how much margin you want to keep, which discounts you consider, and how Vinbot should behave in each case.
points: Set limits before enabling an automation.
Align responses with the value of each item.
Avoid improvising discounts when many conversations are open.
feature_blocks.closing: A clear strategy lets you automate with more judgement and keep the control.

feature_blocks.title: Keep an eye on what is active, pending and needs review
feature_blocks.text: From a single view you can check the status of your catalogue and quickly see which items are active, which are still in draft and which listings need action.
points: Check the overall status of your inventory at a glance.
Locate active items, drafts, sales and reservations.
Review or relist each item directly from its record.
feature_blocks.closing: Less time jumping between lists and more clarity over your operations.

faq.question: What can Vinbot do?
faq.answer: Vinbot brings together tools to prepare listings, keep your items active, respond to buyer interest and configure automations according to how you sell.

faq.question: Do I need to enable every feature?
faq.answer: No. You can activate only the tools that fit your workflow and leave the rest off until you are ready to try them.

faq.question: Can I review the setup before activating it?
faq.answer: Yes. Vinbot is designed so you can define rules, margins and messages before activating any automation.

faq.question: Is Vinbot affiliated with Vinted?
faq.answer: No. Vinbot is an independent service and is not affiliated with, associated with or endorsed by Vinted.

faq.question: How do I request access?
faq.answer: Click “Request early access” and complete the process directly from Vinbot.

faq.question: What languages are available?
faq.answer: Vinbot is available in Spanish, Catalan, English and French.
